tools.name: deepstack_search
tools.description: Use when the user asks where informed investors disagree on a topic of the AI economy, or wants DeepStack’s published analysis on a company, a person or a question; returns the matching stories, sides, tests and entities with their canonical URLs, or answers “DeepStack has no formed side on …” with

tools.name: deepstack_story
tools.description: Use when the user wants one Part of The Buildout read in full, by slug or part number: headline, dek, The DeepStack Call (stance, conviction, three actions, what would change the call, the side it takes and the case against it, the next dated test), key numbers, the full text as plain paragraphs, th

tools.name: deepstack_sides
tools.description: Use when the user asks for the bull and bear case, who disagrees with a thesis, the counter-argument, or what would change a side’s mind. Returns, for one story by slug or part number, The DeepStack Call and its side, every attributed, paraphrased voice on each side with its date and source link, th

tools.name: deepstack_docket
tools.description: Use when the user asks what will decide a dispute, what to watch, or the next dated test. Returns the dated tests that will settle each story, from today forward: date and precision, status, the event, the resolver (which series, release or earnings print decides it) and the story, each with its URL

tools.name: deepstack_results
tools.description: Use when the user asks what resolved and how the Call fared. Returns the tests that came in: verdict, what happened with the primary source and the number, what it did to the Call, and the rule that no hit rate is shown until ten results exist.

tools.name: deepstack_entity
tools.description: Use when the user asks what the voices argued about a company, or what a person argued, in The Buildout; by slug, ticker or name. Returns where it appears, the figures the stories reported, each argument attributed, dated and linked, and for a listed company the delayed market snapshot with its sour

tools.name: deepstack_tape
tools.description: Use when the user asks for the macro figures DeepStack tests its notes against, each with its producer and date: Treasury yields, the real yield, the S&P 500, VIX, Brent, US natural gas, copper, the Fed funds target, CPI and payrolls, with the weekly change and the as-of time of each series.

tools.name: deepstack_counter
tools.description: Use when the user states a thesis or a claim about the AI economy and wants the strongest case against it. Returns the side the claim sits on (or the question, when no side label fits), the strongest case against that side from a voice outside it, dated and linked, more opposing voices, and the date

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: deepstack_search, deepstack_story · Public sink: deepstack_docket.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: deepstack_search, deepstack_story · Public sink: deepstack_docket

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
